tagline: A global diversified media and information services company
hero_kpi_rationale: The Dow Jones segment generates an increasing share of recurring revenue through digital subscriptions (e.g., The Wall Street Journal), making it the primary structural driver of growth and margin expansion.

kpis.name: Recurring / subscription revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from digital subscriptions and recurring services, such as those from The Wall Street Journal or Dow Jones Risk & Compliance.
kpis.description: Subscription revenues have become a key pillar, particularly through Dow Jones, with strong customer retention and increased monetization of digital products.
kpis.signal: Stable growth in digital subscriptions despite pressure on traditional media.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deducting direct costs, a measure of operational profitability.
kpis.description: The shift toward digital and recurring models improves cost structure and overall profitability.
kpis.signal: Margin improvement driven by growth in high-margin digital services.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue, measuring operational performance.
kpis.description: Operating margin is expanding due to cost discipline and growth in high-margin segments such as Dow Jones and Digital Real Estate.
kpis.signal: Sustained improvement driven by cost reductions in print media and scaling of digital segments.

kpis.name: R&D investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Spending on innovation and development of digital products relative to revenue.
kpis.description: R&D spending is moderate but focused on enhancing digital platforms and data analytics.
kpis.signal: Targeted investments in digital tools and AI for information services.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical and digital assets to support growth, particularly in digital platforms.
kpis.description: Investments are concentrated on technology platforms, data security, and user experience.
kpis.signal: Capex directed toward digital infrastructure and cybersecurity, not semiconductor manufacturing.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees worldwide, reflecting the size of the organization.
kpis.description: The company has streamlined its workforce, particularly in traditional segments, while strengthening digital teams.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in headcount, aligned with operational efficiency efforts.

kpis.name: Volume of AI API calls
kpis.explanation: Number of calls to application programming interfaces using artificial intelligence in information services.
kpis.description: Dow Jones uses AI to enrich its databases, automate risk analysis, and enhance document search via Factiva.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth in AI usage for analytical and research tools.

kpis.name: Net bookings
kpis.explanation: Value of new contracts signed for information and analytical services.
kpis.description: Enterprises are expanding subscriptions to compliance tools, energy analytics, and economic intelligence services.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in bookings within professional services (Dow Jones Risk, Energy).

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $8.452 Bn for the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $1.18 Bn for the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company faces substantial cybersecurity threats that could compromise its sensitive data, IT systems, and operations. Cybersecurity insurance may not cover all damages.

risks.title: Data regulation and privacy
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict and evolving regulations regarding personal data protection and data security across multiple jurisdictions.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market, including against news aggregators, social networks, and emerging AI technologies.

risks.title: Intellectual property and generative AI
risks.score_rationale: Unauthorized use of content, including via generative AI, poses a threat to intellectual property-based revenues.

risks.title: Reputation
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputational risks that could impact its business, particularly as a provider of trusted information.

ai_positioning.summary: News Corporation integrates artificial intelligence and machine learning into its information services, particularly at Dow Jones for data enrichment, risk analysis automation, and document search via Factiva. Mentions of generative AI in the context of intellectual property risks indicate awareness of emerging AI-related challenges.
evidence: Dow Jones uses AI to enrich its databases and automate risk analysis
Factiva enhances document search via AI
Mentioning of 'generative AI' risks related to unauthorized use and intellectual property
AI API calls growing at +150% YoY (1.2B calls)
